limitations: A declaration/default policy, not a general EditorConfig parser, content formatter or byte-custody proof.
The reference intentionally admits a small canonical section grammar and exact safe POSIX exception paths, not every legal EditorConfig glob.
The consumer must identify protected/generated inputs before adopting defaults; reason text cannot itself verify that classification.
